<!-- One toolchanger or one kind of fix per pull request. -->

**Toolchanger:**
**Change:** new row / fixed row / new pictures / other

Checks:

- [ ] The row follows [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/vvchik/awesome-toolchangers/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): right section, sorted by stars or likes.
- [ ] Every link is direct (CAD, BOM, manual), none goes to a homepage or a shop.
- [ ] Counts come from the creator's own pages and videos only.
- [ ] The change time has a source link, or the cell is `—`.
- [ ] New pictures: the toolchanger page credits the author, and `0-<slug>.jpg` is the main picture.
